title: ShortsManifest
description: Per-episode manifest describing each Short to render. Consumed by remotion-templates/scripts/render-shorts.mjs to produce 1080x1920 MP4s (or frame-30 PNGs in --preview mode).

episode.description: Episode slug. Must match the parent directory under episodes/. Used for output filenames and provenance only — the renderer does NOT cross-reference data/episodes/<slug>/ to resolve `data` blocks (those are inline).

version.description: Optional manifest schema version. Bump when fields change.

id.description: Zero-padded ordinal ("01", "02", ...). Used in output filename short-<id>.mp4 and in CLI --only/--from filters.

label.description: Human-readable description of the short. Logged at render time; not consumed by the template.

template.description: Remotion composition ID for one of the 9 Shorts templates. Must match exactly what's registered in src/templates/Shorts/index.tsx.

data.description: Template-specific data shape. Same JSON the long-form composition would accept (e.g. StatRevealData, QuoteData, DataChartData). The renderer passes this through to the composition as `{ data: ... }` props.

durationSec.description: Optional override of the duration (in seconds) for this short. If present, it is injected into `data.durationSec` before render so calculateMetadata picks it up. If absent, the template's own `data.durationSec` or built-in default applies. YouTube Shorts max 60s.

sourceBeat.description: Optional provenance — which beat of the source episode this short adapts (e.g. "Beat 3: The Other Side of the Wall"). Documentation only.
